rows: Business AI credits, per seat per month
record.who: All plans; the credit and storage details are shown across Free, Plus, Business and Enterprise.
record.read: Notion is turning AI usage into a metered credit allowance per seat, with a second pool where the customer picks the model. Storage caps make the Free plan more clearly limited.
record.caveat: The page is a large rewrite; prices per seat are unchanged and some entries (Research mode, basic and premium connections) no longer appear. The extent of changes for existing customers is unknown.
